_readme: Recall probe (COLLECTION.md s3), run 2026-09-27 after the membership pass. Independent lists diffed against the base; every candidate lands as a row or a recorded rejection.

sources.source: the firm's portfolio roll-call posts (2019 fund II, 2021 5th anniversary, 2022 and 2023 reviews, 2023 fintech map, 2024 consumer post, 2025 review)
the firm's stories archive, every investment post (172 posts) and the 2017-2020 articles (38)
Google News press sweep: 'led by EQT Ventures', 'EQT Ventures leads', 'EQT Ventures raises', one query per phrase per year 2016-2026 (33 queries, all ok, 258 headlines; sources/web/recall-news.json)
EDGAR full-text sweep on 'EQT Ventures', 'EQT Ventures II', 'EQT Ventures III' (25 registrants)
Wikipedia insource sweep on 'EQT Ventures' (30 articles)
the archived job board jobs.eqtventures.com (46 company slugs, 2019-2020)
EQT's 2016-05-26 release (first five investments), the 2019-11-13 release (Motherbrain's five), the 2022-11-09 release (the nine EUR 1B+ companies)

outcomes.name: Bluebook

outcomes.name: Noomi
outcomes.basis: Aifloo renamed Noomi (2018) and Nectarine Health (2019): one company, merged into nectarine-health

outcomes.name: Iris
outcomes.basis: named once in the firm's 2024 list of 'household names' it has backed; no company of that name is found with EQT Ventures on any list, archive, post, press search (Google News, web) or filing. Kept as an open lead for Erik rather than a row that could only read undetermined.

outcomes.name: Crisp
outcomes.basis: the Tech.eu story on its EUR 35M round (2023-11-16) names no EQT fund among existing or new investors

outcomes.name: BCB Group
outcomes.basis: its $60M Series A (Jan 2022) was co-led by Foundation Capital and Backed; no EQT fund participated (The Block; the company's release)

outcomes.name: SHL Medical
outcomes.basis: an EQT private-equity holding (decisions.md D3), not an EQT Ventures fund

outcomes.name: UserTesting
outcomes.basis: IPO news matched on the query phrase; no EQT Ventures position
